messages:
anjali: Running the onboarding sample under load I hit a token refresh storm + 429s. Repro: start sample with --token-ttl=4s and run 15 concurrent clients for 20s.

tom: Can you paste logs + headers?

anjali: Logs: 
```
[2026-03-02T14:02:01Z] uid=u7 req=1 status=401 msg="token expired"
[2026-03-02T14:02:01Z] uid=u7 refresh.start
[2026-03-02T14:02:01Z] uid=u7 req=2 status=429 Retry-After: 1
[2026-03-02T14:02:02Z] uid=u7 req=3 status=429
[2026-03-02T14:02:03Z] uid=u7 refresh.done token=tok_xyz
[2026-03-02T14:02:04Z] uid=u7 req=4 status=200
```
Observed: sometimes Retry-After header, sometimes not. Multiple SDK clients did refresh concurrently. JS SDK retried 429s automatically; Python raised. No Idempotency-Key set.

ryan: Two-fold fix: (1) SDKs should implement single-flight token refresh to avoid parallel refresh requests, (2) standardize 429 handling + idempotency behavior across SDKs.

anjali: Implemented quick local fix by adding a single-flight wrapper and auto-attaching Idempotency-Key for POSTs in the sample wrapper. That deduped repeated requests.

tom: For 429 policy: honor Retry-After header when present; otherwise use exponential backoff with full jitter. Recommend: base=100ms, max_attempts=5, sleep=random(0, base * 2**attempt). Also: only auto-retry 429 if request is idempotent or has Idempotency-Key. Expose config: retryOn429 (bool).

ryan: Backend note: idempotency TTL should be >= max retry window (recommend 5m) to avoid duplicate side-effects.

ci-bot: CI job queued for PR with repro + sample fix.

anjali: I'll file SDK parity tickets for JS/Python/Rust to add auth.singleFlight helper and unify 429 semantics, and link the sample-app PR. Thanks for the quick feedback :thumbsup:
